item.title: Independence Within Reach as Polls Show Majority Possible
item.description: The SNP says independence is within reach as new polling suggests the party could secure a majority in the Scottish Parliament ahead of the upcoming election campaign.The post Independence Within Reach as Polls Show Majority Possible appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ticket Prices Frozen as Inverness Caley Thistle Face Raith Rovers in Trophy Final
item.description: Ticket prices have been frozen for the 2025 to 2026 KDM Evolution Trophy final as Inverness Caledonian Thistle face Raith Rovers at the Wyre Stadium at Firhill on 5 April.The post Ticket Prices Frozen as Inverness Caley Thistle Face Raith Rovers in Trophy Final appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Rare Harris Croft With House Plot and Sea Views
item.description: A 15.2 acre croft tenancy at Borsham near Finsbay in the Bays of Harris, including a de crofted house plot with planning permission for a five bedroom home overlooking Loch Finsbay.The post A Rare Harris Croft With House Plot and Sea Views appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Energy Tax Row as Douglas Alexander Accused of Betraying Scottish Workers
item.description: Douglas Alexander faces criticism after the Energy Profits Levy remained in place, with warnings the policy risks harming Scotland’s offshore energy sector and threatening jobs tied to North Sea investment.The post Energy Tax Row as Douglas Alexander Accused of Betraying Scottish Workers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: BBC Debate Night Heads To Ullapool and Audience Applications are Open
item.description: BBC Scotland’s Debate Night is heading to Ullapool on Wednesday 18 March and people from across the Highlands are being invited to apply for free audience tickets and take part in the national political discussion.The post BBC Debate Night Heads To Ullapool and Audience Applications are Open appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Questions Raised Over Tony Blair Institute Report on Scotland’s NHS
item.description: A report from the Tony Blair Institute on transforming Scotland’s NHS has sparked political questions about future healthcare policy and the potential role of private sector involvement.The post Questions Raised Over Tony Blair Institute Report on Scotland’s NHS appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Funding Boost To Help Women Escape Abusive Relationships
item.description: Up to 2,400 women and children across Scotland could receive support to escape abusive relationships after the Scottish Government announced £2 million funding for the Fund to Leave initiative.The post Funding Boost To Help Women Escape Abusive Relationships appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland’s Tech Boom Grows as New Dundee Hub Opens With Lessons for The Highlands
item.description: Scotland’s Techscaler programme has helped founders raise £257 million in investment as a new Dundee hub opens, highlighting growing opportunities for entrepreneurs across the country including in the Highlands and Islands.The post Scotland’s Tech Boom Grows as New Dundee Hub Opens With Lessons for The Highlands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Broken Brexit Britain Faces £580 Income Hit for Households
item.description: New modelling suggests UK household incomes could fall by £580 over the next three years, challenging claims families will be better off and intensifying debate about the economy across Scotland and the wider UK.The post Broken Brexit Britain Faces £580 Income Hit for Households appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Alarm Raised Over ‘Salmon Asthma’ Risk Facing Scotland’s Fish Farm Workers
item.description: Concerns are growing about respiratory illness known as “salmon asthma” among workers in Scotland’s salmon industry as a union launches a survey to investigate exposure to bioaerosols in fish farming workplaces.The post Alarm Raised Over ‘Salmon Asthma’ Risk Facing Scotland’s Fish Farm Workers appeared first on The Highland Times.
